reference: Apple HIG Writing re-read 2026-11-09 in browser: 'Choose words that are easily understood and convey the right thing. Check each word to be sure it needs to be there. law: Exactly one create affordance per state on the teacher Classes page: zero classes → the friendly 'Create your first class' empty-state CTA alone; at least one class → the header 'Create class' control alone. Modal, creation flow, ?create=1 deep link and copy untouched.
persona_note: Every probe registered a REAL fresh teacher through the live register → onboarding journey; the landed workspace topbar captured 'Personal · Teacher' in the body text of every run. (The wizard's aria-pressed state was sometimes cleared by the time the persona check ran after a forward click, so the probe relies on the recorded topbar string as the persona evidence.) The app-wide sidebar command-palette quick action 'Create a class' (present on every page, both sides, opens the same modal via the deep link) is outside the two equal page-level controls of the accepted defect pair and is not counted.
